status: parameter-study-only; hardware model not qualified for publication

cell.name: One XTAR protected INR21700-50E 5000 mAh button-top

mapping: Clamp each shared Godot RGB channel times electrical brightness to [0,1], round to the nearest 8-bit PWM code; no optical gamma, shader brightness, reflections or glow. A modeling scenario, not a delivered firmware cap.

evidence.claim: Selected protected button-top INR21700-50E: 3.6 V nominal, 5000 mAh nominal, overcharge/over-discharge/short protection. Nominal 18 Wh is not guaranteed usable energy or a qualified recovery/thermal/fault bound.
Manufacturer describes 256 WS2812 LEDs and theoretical 60 mA per LED at full white. Equal 20 mA channels are a model assumption, not measured individual channel coefficients.
Regulator minimum input is 2.9 V; typical no-load quiescent current below 1 mA is not a maximum efficiency or quiescent bound.
Ring stock remains unresolved. The same 20 mA channel / 1 mA idle study coefficients are not qualified strip ratings.

uncertainty: LED idle, strip channel coefficients, non-LED average/radio duty, conversion efficiency, contact resistance, cutoff reserve and quiescent input are explicit study assumptions. No runtime prediction or protection/thermal rating may be published from these inputs. Sampled peaks do not bound PWM, radio, inrush or faults. Physical runtime is unmeasured.
